description: The intra-cluster streaming protocol is named two different ways in one directory with no link between them: search-service.md writes 'the DCP protocol' (abbreviation only, never expanded on the page) and analytics-service.md writes 'Database Change Protocol' (expansion only, no abbreviation). A reader of either page cannot connect it to the other, and a reader of neither has no way to learn the term. This is the surface cause of the corpus minting two ids for one protocol (protocol:dcp and server:dcp-protocol) in a single round - see the protocol:dcp registry record, which folds them.
